name: The Unwritten Door · English
description: An unopened letter and a phone shape the place that waits outside. One door, and a new scene written as you go.

intro.hook: On a rainy night you wake in a cabin with no memory. An unopened letter and a dead phone decide what world waits beyond the door.
loop: Look at the letter and the phone; decide whether to open them
Open the door — the AI writes a new place and picture from your choices, on the spot
Head out with Iris: no script — roll your way through whatever is out there

characters.line: She got here before you, and speaks only of what she has seen herself

intro.unfinished: In development: only the opening cabin is written and everything beyond the door is generated; three endings are in, but their pictures are still placeholders.

author: AIRP

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Iris came in from the only other door, because she saw the lamp go on. She has been in this place longer than you and still cannot say what is outside; she has learned to report what she has seen and to leave the rest alone.

triggers.label: The player leaves for good with Iris

when.intent: The player clearly decides to leave this place for good together with Iris: asks her to come and sets out with her, not coming back. A walk outside and back, a question or a maybe does not count.

triggers.fallback: Iris looks at the door, then back at you. "We don't even know what's out there yet. Let's see it once, and then ask me again."

triggers.label: The player says who they are

when.intent: The player states, as their own conclusion, who they are or how they came to this cabin, from what the letter, the call or the outside actually revealed. A guess, question or musing does not count.

triggers.fallback: You reach for it and it slips away. Whatever you are, the door has not shown you yet. Go and see what is on the other side first.

triggers.label: The player decides to stay in the cabin

when.intent: The player clearly decides to stay in the cabin for good: not to open the door or go out again, but to remain here with Iris. Resting a while, hesitating or asking does not count.
